steps.name: plan the pages
steps.note: The page size is a setting, not a constant, so it lives in the configuration Flow. Planning first and walking the list second is what lets the pages run in parallel.

steps.name: handle one page
steps.note: Multi Instance runs this Sub Process once per element of the list it receives; PackSize caps how many run together. Inside, Input is one page, not the list, and the outer Parameters are reached through Root.

documentation: Plans the pages first, then walks them with Multi Instance.
